product_direction: Pluggable health metric sync, starting with body weight sync into Garmin Connect.

features.title: Create project harness and PRD
features.description: Define the HealthSync v0.1 product scope, agent instructions, feature list, and progress log.
acceptance_criteria: docs/PRD.md exists and describes the v0.1 scope.
AGENTS.md exists and gives future agents implementation guidance.
harness/feature_list.json tracks the implementation queue.
harness/progress.md records initial decisions.

features.title: Add canonical WeightMeasurement model
features.description: Create the internal model used between source and destination adapters.
acceptance_criteria: A WeightMeasurement model exists with source, measured_at, weight_kg, optional body composition fields, and metadata.
The model can produce a stable sync key for duplicate detection.
Basic validation prevents missing timestamp or invalid weight values.

features.title: Add adapter interfaces
features.description: Define source and destination interfaces for weight sync.
acceptance_criteria: A source interface can fetch weight measurements.
A destination interface can upload a weight measurement.
The sync engine can depend on interfaces instead of concrete providers.

features.title: Add file-based weight source
features.description: Support local testing from a JSON or CSV weight export before Zepp Life integration is confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: A sample data file can be loaded locally.
Records are normalized into WeightMeasurement objects.
Invalid records are skipped or rejected with clear errors.

features.title: Add sync state for duplicate prevention
features.description: Persist successfully synced measurement keys to prevent duplicate uploads.
acceptance_criteria: A file-based sync state works locally.
Already synced measurements are skipped.
Failed uploads are not marked as synced.

features.title: Add dry-run destination
features.description: Provide a safe destination for testing sync logic without touching Garmin.
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run mode logs or returns the measurements that would be uploaded.
Dry-run can be used in tests.
Dry-run does not require provider credentials.

features.title: Add Garmin weight destination
features.description: Upload canonical weight measurements into Garmin Connect.
acceptance_criteria: Garmin credentials are read from environment variables.
Authentication failure is handled clearly.
Successful upload marks the measurement as synced.
Provider-specific mapping stays inside the Garmin adapter.

features.title: Decide Zepp Life source path
features.description: Confirm the practical way to extract Zepp Life weight data.
acceptance_criteria: The selected source path is documented.
Risks and limitations are recorded.
The implementation plan is updated based on the confirmed path.

features.title: Add cloud function entrypoint
features.description: Expose the sync as an HTTP-triggered Google Cloud Function after local sync works.
acceptance_criteria: The HTTP entrypoint reuses the sync engine.
Local functions-framework execution is documented.
Cloud environment variables are documented.
